title: neurophyllodes cuneata
intro: Neurophyllodes cuneata, commonly known as Devil's Claw, is a medicinal plant native to Africa. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including reducing inflammation and pain, as well as improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Neurophyllodes cuneata include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and anti-spasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, specifically harpagoside, which is responsible for its medicinal properties.
